subject: Signal and System
questionText:
Consider a continuous-time system with input x(t) and 
output y(t) given by 
 
x(t) = y(t) cos(t) 
 
The system is 
 
 (a) Linear and time-invariant 
 
(b) Non-linear and time-invariant 
 
 
(c) Linear and time-varying 
 
(d) Non-linear and time-varying
explanation: Practice Question from Signal and System DPP-06 (Types of System).
